summary: National Grid plc furnished a Form 6-K carrying its half-year results for the period ended 30 September 2026, published to the London Stock Exchange on 5 November 2026. Underlying operating profit rose 13% to £2,591m and underlying EPS 22% to 36.5p, on record capital investment of £6,707m, up 33%. The interim dividend is 16.97p. The release cites £70bn of planned five-year network investment and non-recurring divestment gains, but discloses no transaction terms, stake, price, premium, advisor or regulatory clock. It is a routine earnings filing, not a special situation; watch capital delivery and RIIO-T3 outcomes.
